functions.name: janet_nanbox_to_pointer
functions.description: Convert a nanboxed Janet value to a void* pointer, extracting the payload for pointer-like types under the 64-bit nanboxing build.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_64 is defined (64-bit nanboxing build).
Caller must pass a value x that is a pointer-like Janet type (e.g., array, table, function, abstract, etc.); behavior is undefined for non-pointer payloads.

functions.name: janet_nanbox_from_pointer
functions.description: Create a nanboxed Janet from a pointer p with a given 64-bit tagmask (high bits encode the Janet type).
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_64 is defined.
tagmask must be an appropriate JANET_NANBOX tag mask for the intended Janet type (e.g., janet_nanbox_tag(T)).
Pointer p should be suitably aligned for the runtime; NULL is allowed for some types but semantics depend on type.

functions.name: janet_nanbox_from_cpointer
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_nanbox_from_cpointer(const void *p, uint64_t tagmask);
functions.description: Create a nanboxed Janet from a const pointer payload and specified tagmask under 64-bit nanboxing.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_64 is defined.
tagmask must be a valid JANET_NANBOX tag for the target type.
p may be NULL depending on type; usage mirrors janet_nanbox_from_pointer but enforces const pointer provenance.

functions.name: janet_nanbox_from_double
functions.description: Create a nanboxed Janet representing a numeric double under 64-bit nanboxing.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_64 is defined.
d is any finite or non-finite double; NaN boxing logic will encode appropriately.

functions.name: janet_nanbox_from_bits
functions.description: Create a Janet value directly from raw 64-bit bits under 64-bit nanboxing.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_64 is defined.
bits must form a valid Janet nanbox encoding; incorrect encodings lead to undefined behavior.

functions.name: janet_nanbox32_from_tagi
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_nanbox32_from_tagi(uint32_t tag, int32_t integer);
functions.description: Construct a 32-bit nanboxed Janet from a type tag and 32-bit integer payload.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_32 is defined.
tag must be a valid JanetType tag or reserved special for numbers per nanbox32 encoding.
integer is the payload for boolean or small integer-like immediate representations.

functions.name: janet_nanbox32_from_tagp
functions.description: Construct a 32-bit nanboxed Janet from a type tag and pointer payload.
requirements: Available only when JANET_NANBOX_32 is defined.
tag must be a valid pointer-bearing JanetType.
pointer should be valid/aligned for the runtime; NULL semantics depend on type.

functions.name: janet_checkint16
functions.description: Check if x is representable as a signed 16-bit integer.
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to int16_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkuint16
functions.description: Check if x is representable as an unsigned 16-bit integer.
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to uint16_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkint
functions.description: Check if x is representable as a signed 32-bit integer.
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to int32_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkuint
functions.description: Check if x is representable as an unsigned 32-bit integer.
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to uint32_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkint64
functions.description: Check if x is representable as a signed 64-bit integer (within exact integerable double range).
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to int64_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkuint64
functions.description: Check if x is representable as an unsigned 64-bit integer (within exact integerable double range).
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to uint64_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checksize
functions.description: Check if x is representable as a size_t (platform-dependent width).
requirements: x must be a Janet value; returns non-zero if convertible to size_t, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: janet_checkabstract
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetAbstract janet_checkabstract(Janet x, const JanetAbstractType *at);
functions.description: Ensure x is an abstract value of the given abstract type at and return the raw abstract pointer.
requirements: x must be a Janet value.
at must be a valid registered abstract type.
On type mismatch, behavior is to either return NULL or signal an error depending on implementation (unknown from header).

functions.name: janet_async_start_fiber
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_async_start_fiber(JanetFiber *fiber, JanetStream *stream, JanetAsyncMode mode, JanetEVCallback callback, void *state);
functions.description: Begin listening for async events on stream on the given root fiber; sets up event dispatch and arranges for fiber scheduling.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
fiber must be a root schedulable fiber (intended for event loop).
stream must be a valid JanetStream registered with the event loop.
mode selects read/write/both.
callback must be a valid function pointer and will be invoked with events.
state may be NULL or a janet_malloc-allocated pointer; on Windows, state must have an OVERLAPPED struct at offset 0.
Caller should call janet_await() before returning from the C function after starting (per comment).

functions.name: janet_async_start
functions.signature: JANET_API JANET_NO_RETURN void janet_async_start(JanetStream *stream, JanetAsyncMode mode, JanetEVCallback callback, void *state);
functions.description: Begin listening for async events on the current root fiber and immediately yield (no-return) by awaiting the event loop.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
No-return: does not return to caller; control transfers via event loop scheduling.
stream, mode, callback, state requirements as in janet_async_start_fiber.
On Windows, state must contain OVERLAPPED at offset 0.

functions.name: janet_async_end
functions.description: Stop sending events to the given fiber’s registered callback; call after scheduling the fiber to resume or cancel.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
fiber must be a fiber previously started/listening for async events.

functions.name: janet_async_in_flight
functions.description: Mark a fiber as waiting for an in-flight IOCP completion (Windows). No-op on other platforms.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
Meaningful only on Windows; fiber should be a fiber awaiting Windows IOCP operation.

functions.name: janet_stream_edge_triggered
functions.description: Configure the stream’s event mode to edge-triggered where supported.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
stream must be a valid JanetStream created via janet_stream or janet_stream_ext.
Platform support may vary; semantics are platform-dependent.

functions.name: janet_stream_level_triggered
functions.description: Configure the stream’s event mode to level-triggered where supported.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
stream must be valid; platform support may vary.

functions.name: janet_atomic_inc
functions.description: Atomically increment x and return the new or previous value (unspecified in header). Used for synchronization.
requirements: x must be a valid pointer to a JanetAtomicInt.
Thread-safe; memory ordering unspecified beyond atomicity (unknown).

functions.name: janet_atomic_dec
functions.description: Atomically decrement x and return the new or previous value (unspecified in header).
requirements: x must be a valid pointer to a JanetAtomicInt.

functions.name: janet_atomic_load
functions.description: Atomically load x with default/stronger memory ordering (exact semantics unspecified).
requirements: x must be a valid pointer to a JanetAtomicInt.

functions.name: janet_atomic_load_relaxed
functions.description: Atomically load x with relaxed memory ordering.
requirements: x must be a valid pointer to a JanetAtomicInt.

functions.name: janet_struct_head
functions.description: Return the internal header pointer of a struct value for low-level interop.
requirements: st must be a valid JanetStruct.
Caller must not mutate GC-managed internals in unsupported ways.

functions.name: janet_abstract_head
functions.description: Return the internal header pointer for an abstract value.
requirements: abstract must be a valid JanetAbstract pointer (janet_abstract).
Misuse may corrupt GC; treat as read-only unless implementing the type.

functions.name: janet_string_head
functions.description: Return the string header given a JanetString data pointer.
requirements: s must be a valid JanetString.
Primarily for bindings without macros; do not mutate internals.

functions.name: janet_tuple_head
functions.description: Return the tuple header given a JanetTuple pointer.
requirements: tuple must be a valid JanetTuple.
Treat internals as read-only.

functions.name: janet_type
functions.description: Return the dynamic type tag of a Janet value.
requirements: x is any Janet; no special requirements.

functions.name: janet_checktype
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_checktype(Janet x, JanetType type);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x has the exact type or, under nanboxing, if it’s a number when type is JANET_NUMBER.
requirements: x is any Janet.
type is a value from JanetType.

functions.name: janet_checktypes
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_checktypes(Janet x, int typeflags);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x’s type bit is present in typeflags (bitmask of JANET_TFLAG_*).
requirements: typeflags must be a bitmask composed from JANET_TFLAG_* macros.

functions.name: janet_truthy
functions.description: Return whether a Janet value is truthy (not nil and not false).
requirements: x is any Janet.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_struct
functions.description: Extract a JanetStruct pointer from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a struct; otherwise behavior is undefined or may crash; caller should check type first.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_tuple
functions.description: Extract a JanetTuple pointer from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a tuple; caller should validate type.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_fiber
functions.description: Extract a JanetFiber* from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a fiber.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_array
functions.description: Extract a JanetArray* from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be an array.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_table
functions.description: Extract a JanetTable* from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a table.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_buffer
functions.description: Extract a JanetBuffer* from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a buffer.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_string
functions.description: Extract a JanetString from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a string.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_symbol
functions.description: Extract a JanetSymbol from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a symbol.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_keyword
functions.description: Extract a JanetKeyword from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a keyword.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_abstract
functions.description: Extract a raw JanetAbstract pointer from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be an abstract value; you should know its concrete type before using.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_pointer
functions.description: Extract a raw void* pointer from a Janet value of type JANET_POINTER.
requirements: x must be of type JANET_POINTER.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_function
functions.description: Extract a JanetFunction* (bytecode function) from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a function (not cfunction).

functions.name: janet_unwrap_cfunction
functions.description: Extract a C function pointer (JanetCFunction) from a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a cfunction.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_boolean
functions.description: Extract the boolean payload as int (0/1) from a Janet value of type JANET_BOOLEAN.
requirements: x must be a boolean.

functions.name: janet_unwrap_number
functions.description: Extract the numeric double payload from a Janet number.
requirements: x must be a number or representable as number under the build.
If x is not a number, behavior is undefined; check first.

functions.description: Construct a Janet representing nil.

functions.name: janet_wrap_number
functions.description: Wrap a C double into a Janet number.

functions.name: janet_wrap_false

functions.name: janet_wrap_boolean

functions.name: janet_wrap_string

requirements: x must be a valid JanetString allocated by Janet.

functions.name: janet_wrap_symbol
functions.description: Wrap a JanetSymbol pointer as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetSymbol.

functions.name: janet_wrap_keyword

requirements: x must be a valid JanetKeyword.

functions.name: janet_wrap_array

requirements: x must be a valid JanetArray*.

functions.name: janet_wrap_tuple
functions.description: Wrap a JanetTuple pointer as a Janet value.

functions.name: janet_wrap_struct
functions.description: Wrap a JanetStruct pointer as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetStruct.

functions.name: janet_wrap_fiber
functions.description: Wrap a JanetFiber* as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetFiber*.

functions.name: janet_wrap_buffer
functions.description: Wrap a JanetBuffer* as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetBuffer*.

functions.name: janet_wrap_function
functions.description: Wrap a JanetFunction* (bytecode) as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetFunction*.

functions.name: janet_wrap_cfunction
functions.description: Wrap a C function pointer as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetCFunction (Janet (*)(int32_t, Janet*)).

functions.name: janet_wrap_table
functions.description: Wrap a JanetTable* as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid JanetTable*.

functions.name: janet_wrap_abstract
functions.description: Wrap a JanetAbstract pointer as a Janet value.
requirements: x must be a valid abstract pointer created by Janet APIs.

functions.name: janet_wrap_pointer
functions.description: Wrap an arbitrary C pointer as a JANET_POINTER value.
requirements: x is any pointer; consumers must understand the payload.

functions.name: janet_wrap_integer
functions.description: Wrap a 32-bit integer as a Janet number (convenience).
requirements: Note: In some builds this may be a macro to janet_wrap_number((int32_t)x).

functions.name: janet_loop
functions.description: Run the event loop until completion.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
The event loop should have work (streams/fibers) to process.

functions.name: janet_loop_done
functions.description: Return non-zero if the event loop has nothing left to do.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.

functions.name: janet_loop1
functions.description: Run one turn of the event loop; may return an interrupted fiber to handle.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
Caller should handle a possibly non-NULL returned fiber (schedule or cancel).

functions.name: janet_loop1_interrupt
functions.description: Signal an interrupt to allow janet_loop1 to return to user code periodically (cooperative interrupt).
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
vm may be NULL? Header suggests a VM target; pass a valid VM to target a specific loop.

functions.name: janet_stream
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetStream *janet_stream(JanetHandle handle, uint32_t flags, const JanetMethod *methods);
functions.description: Wrap a file descriptor/HANDLE into a JanetStream with default size.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
handle must be a valid OS handle or JANET_HANDLE_NONE for invalid.
flags are JANET_STREAM_* bit flags.
methods may be NULL or point to a methods vtable.

functions.name: janet_stream_ext
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetStream *janet_stream_ext(JanetHandle handle, uint32_t flags, const JanetMethod *methods, size_t size);
functions.description: Like janet_stream but allows custom allocation size for type-punning streams.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
size must be >= sizeof(JanetStream) for extensions.

functions.name: janet_stream_close
functions.description: Close a JanetStream and unregister from event loop.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
stream must be a valid stream; flags may include NOT_CLOSEABLE to prevent OS close.

functions.name: janet_cfun_stream_close

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
Expects appropriate Janet arguments; use janet_get* helpers inside implementation.

functions.name: janet_cfun_stream_read

functions.name: janet_sleep_await

functions.name: janet_addtimeout_nil

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.

functions.name: janet_ev_inc_refcount

functions.name: janet_ev_dec_refcount

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.

atype must be registered; size is abstract payload size.

abst must be a threaded abstract created by the threaded API.

functions.name: janet_abstract_decref

functions.name: janet_channel_make_threaded

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
limit as above.

functions.name: janet_getchannel

functions.name: janet_channel_take
functions.description: Receive a value from channel into out; returns status int.
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
channel must be valid.
out must be a valid pointer to receive the value.

mutex must have been initialized.

functions.name: janet_os_mutex_lock

functions.name: janet_os_mutex_unlock

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_init

rwlock must point to storage of at least janet_os_rwlock_size bytes.

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_deinit
functions.description: Destroy an OS read-write lock.

rwlock must have been initialized.

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_rlock

rwlock must be initialized.

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_wlock

rwlock must be initialized.

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_runlock

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.

functions.name: janet_os_rwlock_wunlock

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV is enabled.
Currently held write lock.

functions.name: janet_ev_lasterr

requirements: Available only when JANET_EV and JANET_NET are enabled.

functions.name: janet_ev_write_buffer

functions.name: janet_ev_send_string
functions.signature: JANET_NO_RETURN JANET_API void janet_ev_send_string(JanetStream *stream, JanetString str, int flags);
functions.description: Asynchronously send the bytes of str on a socket with flags (no-return).
requirements: Available only when JANET_EV and JANET_NET are enabled.

dest must be a valid sockaddr pointer.

functions.name: janet_to_string_b
functions.description: Append the to_string representation of x to buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: janet_description_b
functions.description: Append the human-readable description of x to buffer.
requirements: buffer must be valid.

functions.name: janet_formatc
functions.description: printf-like formatted string creation returning a JanetString.
requirements: format must be a valid format string; varargs types must match specifiers.

functions.name: janet_formatb
functions.description: printf-like formatted append into bufp; returns bufp.
requirements: bufp must be valid; format string and varargs must match.

functions.name: janet_formatbv
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_formatbv(JanetBuffer *bufp, const char *format, va_list args);
functions.description: va_list variant of formatted append into bufp.
requirements: bufp must be valid; args must be initialized with va_start for format.

functions.name: janet_symbol
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetSymbol janet_symbol(const uint8_t *str, int32_t len);
functions.description: Intern a symbol from a byte string of length len.
requirements: str points to len bytes; len >= 0.

functions.name: janet_csymbol
functions.description: Intern a symbol from a null-terminated C string.
requirements: str must be non-NULL and null-terminated.

functions.name: janet_symbol_gen
functions.description: Generate a fresh unique symbol.

functions.name: janet_struct_begin
functions.description: Begin constructing a struct with count key/value pairs; returns writable KV array.
requirements: count >= 0; caller must fill exactly count key/value pairs before janet_struct_end.

functions.name: janet_struct_put
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_struct_put(JanetKV *st, Janet key, Janet value);
functions.description: Write a key/value pair into a struct being built.
requirements: st must be within the KV array returned by janet_struct_begin.
Keys should be hashable; behavior for duplicates depends on end logic.

functions.name: janet_struct_end
functions.description: Finalize struct construction from an array of KVs.
requirements: st must point to the KV array returned by janet_struct_begin.

functions.name: janet_struct_get
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_struct_get(JanetStruct st, Janet key);
functions.description: Lookup a key in a struct (searching prototypes).
requirements: st must be a valid struct; key any Janet.

functions.name: janet_struct_rawget
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_struct_rawget(JanetStruct st, Janet key);
functions.description: Lookup a key in the struct without following prototype chain.
requirements: st must be valid.

functions.name: janet_struct_get_ex
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_struct_get_ex(JanetStruct st, Janet key, JanetStruct *which);
functions.description: Lookup a key and return which struct in the prototype chain held it via which.
requirements: which may be NULL or must point to receive owner struct.

functions.name: janet_struct_to_table
functions.description: Create a mutable table copy of a struct.
requirements: st must be valid.

functions.name: janet_struct_find
functions.signature: JANET_API const JanetKV *janet_struct_find(JanetStruct st, Janet key);
functions.description: Find and return a pointer to KV entry for key or NULL if not found.
requirements: st must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table
functions.description: Create a new mutable table with initial capacity.
requirements: capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_table_init
functions.description: Initialize a provided table storage with capacity.
requirements: table must point to proper storage; capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_table_init_raw
functions.description: Initialize a table without extra features (raw variant).
requirements: table must be valid; capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_table_deinit
functions.description: Deinitialize a table, freeing resources.
requirements: table must have been initialized/allocated by Janet.

functions.name: janet_table_get
functions.description: Get a value by key from table (searching prototypes).
requirements: t must be valid; key any Janet.

functions.name: janet_table_get_ex
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_table_get_ex(JanetTable *t, Janet key, JanetTable **which);
functions.description: Get a value by key and provide which table in the prototype chain had it.
requirements: which may be NULL or must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: janet_table_rawget
functions.description: Get a value by key without following prototype chain.
requirements: t must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table_remove
functions.description: Remove a key from table; return previous value or nil.
requirements: t must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table_put
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_table_put(JanetTable *t, Janet key, Janet value);
functions.description: Insert or replace key->value in table.
requirements: t must be valid; key must be hashable.

functions.name: janet_table_to_struct
functions.description: Create an immutable struct snapshot from table.
requirements: t must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table_merge_table
functions.description: Merge all entries from other into table.
requirements: table and other must be valid.
Conflicts resolved by overwrite (typical).

functions.name: janet_table_merge_struct
functions.description: Merge entries from an immutable struct into a table.
requirements: table must be valid; other must be a valid struct.

functions.name: janet_table_find
functions.description: Find the bucket/entry for key, returning a pointer for direct manipulation.
requirements: t must be valid; key must be hashable.
Returned pointer is internal; mutation must follow API expectations.

functions.name: janet_table_clone
functions.description: Create a shallow clone of table.
requirements: table must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table_clear
functions.description: Remove all entries from table.
requirements: table must be valid.

functions.name: janet_table_weakk
functions.description: Create a table with weak keys.
requirements: capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_table_weakv
functions.description: Create a table with weak values.
requirements: capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_table_weakkv
functions.description: Create a table with weak keys and values.
requirements: capacity >= 0.

functions.name: janet_fiber
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetFiber *janet_fiber(JanetFunction *callee, int32_t capacity, int32_t argc, const Janet *argv);
functions.description: Create a new fiber to call callee with argv, with a given initial stack capacity.
requirements: callee must be a valid JanetFunction.
capacity >= 0; argc >= 0; argv points to argc values.

functions.name: janet_fiber_reset
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetFiber *janet_fiber_reset(JanetFiber *fiber, JanetFunction *callee, int32_t argc, const Janet *argv);
functions.description: Reset an existing fiber to call a (possibly new) callee with arguments.
requirements: fiber must be valid and in a resettable state (not running).
callee, argc, argv as above.

functions.name: janet_fiber_status
functions.description: Get the current status of a fiber (alive, pending, dead, error, etc.).
requirements: fiber must be valid.

functions.name: janet_fiber_can_resume
functions.description: Return non-zero if fiber can be resumed.
requirements: fiber must be valid.

functions.name: janet_current_fiber
functions.description: Return the currently running fiber in this VM thread.

functions.name: janet_root_fiber
functions.description: Return the root fiber for this thread/VM.

functions.name: janet_indexed_view
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_indexed_view(Janet seq, const Janet **data, int32_t *len);
functions.description: If seq is indexed (array/tuple), return a borrowed view of elements in *data and length in *len; return non-zero on success.
requirements: data and len must be non-NULL pointers.

functions.name: janet_bytes_view
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_bytes_view(Janet str, const uint8_t **data, int32_t *len);
functions.description: If str is bytes-like (string/symbol/keyword/buffer), return borrowed byte view.
requirements: data and len must be non-NULL.

functions.name: janet_dictionary_view
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_dictionary_view(Janet tab, const JanetKV **data, int32_t *len, int32_t *cap);
functions.description: If tab is dictionary-like (table/struct), return borrowed KV array view and sizes.
requirements: data, len, cap must be non-NULL.

functions.name: janet_dictionary_get
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_dictionary_get(const JanetKV *data, int32_t cap, Janet key);
functions.description: Lookup key in a raw dictionary array with capacity cap.
requirements: data must point to a dictionary backing array.
cap must be correct for the array.

functions.name: janet_dictionary_next
functions.signature: JANET_API const JanetKV *janet_dictionary_next(const JanetKV *kvs, int32_t cap, const JanetKV *kv);
functions.description: Iterate to the next non-empty KV slot after kv in kvs with capacity cap.
requirements: kvs must be valid; kv may be NULL to start.

functions.name: janet_abstract_begin
functions.description: Begin allocation of an abstract value of a given type and size, returning writable payload pointer.
requirements: type must be registered; size is the payload size in bytes.

functions.name: janet_abstract_end
functions.description: Finalize an abstract allocation begun by janet_abstract_begin, returning the JanetAbstract pointer.
requirements: abstractTemplate must be the pointer returned by janet_abstract_begin.

functions.name: janet_abstract
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetAbstract janet_abstract(const JanetAbstractType *type, size_t size);
functions.description: Allocate and finalize an abstract value in one step.
requirements: type must be registered; size >= sizeof(payload).

functions.name: janet_native
functions.description: Load a native module by name and return its init function pointer; on failure, set error.
requirements: name must be a module identifier; error may be NULL or points to receive an error message string (JanetString).
Dynamic module loading must be enabled unless embedded (build-dependent).

functions.name: janet_marshal
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_marshal(JanetBuffer *buf, Janet x, JanetTable *rreg, int flags);
functions.description: Serialize a Janet value x into buf using a registry rreg and flags.
requirements: buf must be valid; rreg is a registry table (may be NULL).
flags may include JANET_MARSHAL_UNSAFE and JANET_MARSHAL_NO_CYCLES.

functions.name: janet_unmarshal
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_unmarshal(const uint8_t *bytes, size_t len, int flags, JanetTable *reg, const uint8_t **next);
functions.description: Deserialize a Janet value from a byte buffer; optionally return pointer to next unread byte in *next.
requirements: bytes must point to len bytes; len >= 1 for non-empty payloads.
reg is a registry (may be NULL).
next may be NULL or non-NULL to receive position.

functions.name: janet_env_lookup
functions.description: Return the lexical environment lookup table associated with env.
requirements: env must be a valid environment table.

functions.name: janet_env_lookup_into
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_env_lookup_into(JanetTable *renv, JanetTable *env, const char *prefix, int recurse);
functions.description: Populate renv with entries from env matching prefix, optionally recursing.
requirements: renv and env must be valid tables.
prefix may be NULL or a C string.
recurse is a boolean-like int.

functions.name: janet_mark
functions.description: Mark a Janet value for the GC (internal; for implementing containers).
requirements: Must be called during GC marking phases or when implementing custom types; misuse may corrupt GC.

functions.name: janet_sweep
functions.description: Run a GC sweep cycle.
requirements: Should be called in a safe VM state; typically by runtime.

functions.name: janet_collect
functions.description: Trigger a full GC collection.
requirements: Call when safe; the runtime controls most invocations.

functions.name: janet_clear_memory
functions.description: Clear Janet runtime memory (for teardown).
requirements: Should be called during controlled shutdown; not during active execution.

functions.name: janet_gcroot
functions.description: Add a root to prevent GC of a Janet value.
requirements: root is any Janet; must later be unrooted to avoid leaks.

functions.name: janet_gcunroot
functions.description: Remove one root reference to a Janet value; return count or status int.
requirements: root must have been rooted.

functions.name: janet_gcunrootall
functions.description: Remove all root references for a Janet value.
requirements: root must have been rooted.

functions.name: janet_gclock
functions.description: Lock the GC, returning a handle/id used to unlock.
requirements: Must be balanced with janet_gcunlock(handle).

functions.name: janet_gcunlock
functions.description: Unlock the GC using a handle returned by janet_gclock.
requirements: handle must be a handle returned by janet_gclock.

functions.name: janet_gcpressure
functions.description: Inform the GC of external memory pressure s bytes to adjust heuristics.
requirements: s is the size in bytes of external allocations.

functions.name: janet_funcdef_alloc
functions.description: Allocate a new function definition object (uninitialized fields).

functions.name: janet_thunk
functions.description: Create a function object (closure) from a function definition with no environment captures.
requirements: def must be a valid compiled function definition.

functions.name: janet_thunk_delay
functions.description: Create a function that defers evaluation of x (thunk).
requirements: x is any Janet; semantics are runtime-defined (unknown).

functions.name: janet_verify
functions.description: Verify a function definition’s bytecode and metadata; return non-zero if valid.
requirements: def must be valid.

functions.name: janet_pretty
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetBuffer *janet_pretty(JanetBuffer *buffer, int depth, int flags, Janet x);
functions.description: Pretty-print x into buffer with given depth and flags (color, oneline, notrunc).
requirements: buffer must be valid; depth controls recursion; flags is bitmask of JANET_PRETTY_*.

functions.name: janet_init_hash_key
functions.description: Initializes a 16-byte hash key buffer for Janet’s hash/PRF machinery when JANET_PRF is enabled. The function writes JANET_HASH_KEY_SIZE (16) bytes into the provided buffer. Typical usage is to supply a writable 16-byte array and call this during setup to obtain a key used by Janet’s hashing routines. Specific key derivation and lifespan are not documented here and are unknown from this header.
requirements: Only available when compiled with JANET_PRF defined; otherwise the function is not declared.
The key parameter must be a non-NULL pointer to writable storage of at least JANET_HASH_KEY_SIZE (16) bytes.
Caller must provide the storage for key; the function will write into it.
Thread-safety, initialization ordering, and whether this must be called exactly once are not specified and are unknown from the header.

functions.name: janet_try_init
functions.description: Initialize a JanetTryState for exception handling (setjmp/longjmp-based).
requirements: state must be valid; used with janet_try macro and janet_restore.

functions.name: janet_restore
functions.description: Restore VM state saved in JanetTryState after a janet_try block completes.
requirements: state must have been initialized and used with janet_try.

functions.name: janet_equals
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_equals(Janet x, Janet y);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x equals y using Janet equality semantics.

functions.name: janet_hash
functions.description: Compute a 32-bit hash of a Janet value.

functions.name: janet_compare
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_compare(Janet x, Janet y);
functions.description: Three-way comparison; return negative/zero/positive depending on ordering; not all types comparable.

functions.name: janet_cstrcmp
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_cstrcmp(JanetString str, const char *other);
functions.description: Compare a JanetString with a null-terminated C string like strcmp.
requirements: str must be valid; other must be null-terminated.

functions.name: janet_in
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_in(Janet ds, Janet key);
functions.description: Return non-nil if key is in the data structure ds (tables, structs, arrays strings, etc.).
requirements: ds must be a supported data structure; key type depends on ds.

functions.name: janet_get
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_get(Janet ds, Janet key);
functions.description: Get a value by key from a data structure ds (polymorphic).
requirements: ds must support get by key; key must be appropriate type.

functions.name: janet_next
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_next(Janet ds, Janet key);
functions.description: Return the next iteration key for ds after key, or nil when done.
requirements: ds must be a supported iterable; key is the previous key or nil to start.

functions.name: janet_getindex
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_getindex(Janet ds, int32_t index);
functions.description: Get an element by integer index from an indexed ds (array/tuple/string/buffer).
requirements: index within bounds for ds; negative indexes likely unsupported (unknown).

functions.name: janet_length
functions.description: Return the length of x if lengthable, otherwise 0 or error (unspecified).

functions.name: janet_lengthv
functions.description: Return the length of x wrapped as a Janet value.

functions.name: janet_put
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_put(Janet ds, Janet key, Janet value);
functions.description: Set key to value in a mutable data structure ds (e.g., table, buffer index).
requirements: ds must be a mutable structure supporting put; key/value must be appropriate.

functions.name: janet_putindex
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_putindex(Janet ds, int32_t index, Janet value);
functions.description: Set element at index in a mutable indexed structure.
requirements: index within bounds; ds must support indexed put (array, buffer).

functions.name: janet_wrap_number_safe
functions.description: Wrap a double as a Janet number, possibly handling NaN-boxing edge-cases safely.

functions.name: janet_keyeq
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_keyeq(Janet x, const char *cstring);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x is a keyword equal to the given C string.
requirements: cstring must be null-terminated.

functions.name: janet_streq
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_streq(Janet x, const char *cstring);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x is a string equal to the given C string.
requirements: cstring must be null-terminated.

functions.name: janet_symeq
functions.signature: JANET_API int janet_symeq(Janet x, const char *cstring);
functions.description: Return non-zero if x is a symbol equal to the given C string.
requirements: cstring must be null-terminated.

functions.name: janet_sorted_keys
functions.signature: JANET_API int32_t janet_sorted_keys(const JanetKV *dict, int32_t cap, int32_t *index_buffer);
functions.description: Produce indices of occupied keys in order into index_buffer; return number of keys.
requirements: dict must be a dictionary backing array with capacity cap.
index_buffer must have capacity >= number of keys.

functions.name: janet_init
functions.description: Initialize the Janet VM for the current thread/process; return non-zero on success.
requirements: Must be called before most other Janet APIs unless using janet_local_vm().
May be called once per process or per thread depending on embedding model (unspecified).

functions.name: janet_deinit
functions.description: Deinitialize the Janet VM, freeing resources.
requirements: Should be paired with janet_init; ensure no live Janet values remain referenced.

functions.name: janet_vm_alloc
functions.description: Allocate a new JanetVM state object.

functions.name: janet_local_vm
functions.description: Return the current thread-local JanetVM.
requirements: Must be called after janet_init or appropriate setup.

functions.name: janet_vm_free
functions.description: Free a JanetVM previously allocated with janet_vm_alloc.
requirements: vm must be a VM allocated by janet_vm_alloc and not the local VM unless explicitly allowed (unspecified).

functions.name: janet_vm_save
functions.description: Save the current thread’s Janet VM state into into.
requirements: into must be a valid JanetVM pointer.

functions.name: janet_vm_load
functions.description: Load a previously saved Janet VM state from from into the current thread.
requirements: from must be a valid JanetVM pointer saved by janet_vm_save.

functions.name: janet_interpreter_interrupt
functions.description: Interrupt the interpreter associated with vm (e.g., to break out from long computation).
requirements: vm must be valid.

functions.name: janet_interpreter_interrupt_handled
functions.description: Notify that a previously set interpreter interrupt has been handled.
requirements: vm must be valid.

functions.signature: JANET_API JanetSignal janet_continue_signal(JanetFiber *fiber, Janet in, Janet *out, JanetSignal sig);
functions.description: Resume fiber with a specific signal sig and input in; write output to out.
requirements: sig must be a valid JanetSignal.
fiber must be resumable; out non-NULL.

functions.name: janet_pcall
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetSignal janet_pcall(JanetFunction *fun, int32_t argn, const Janet *argv, Janet *out, JanetFiber **f);
functions.description: Protected call to a Janet function; returns a signal (OK or ERROR), places result in out; optionally returns fiber used in *f.
requirements: fun must be a valid function; argn >= 0; argv points to argn Janets.
out must be non-NULL.
f may be NULL or non-NULL to receive the fiber.

functions.name: janet_step
functions.signature: JANET_API JanetSignal janet_step(JanetFiber *fiber, Janet in, Janet *out);
functions.description: Step a fiber one timeslice/instruction group; returns a signal.
requirements: fiber must be valid; out non-NULL.

functions.name: janet_call
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_call(JanetFunction *fun, int32_t argc, const Janet *argv);
functions.description: Call a Janet function and return its result or raise/panic on error.
requirements: fun must be valid; argc >= 0; argv points to argc Janets.

functions.name: janet_mcall
functions.signature: JANET_API Janet janet_mcall(const char *name, int32_t argc, Janet *argv);
functions.description: Call a Janet method/function by name with arguments argv.
requirements: name must be a C string; argc >= 0; argv points to argc Janets.

functions.name: janet_stacktrace
functions.description: Print or record a stacktrace for fiber with error value err.
requirements: fiber must be valid.

functions.name: janet_stacktrace_ext
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_stacktrace_ext(JanetFiber *fiber, Janet err, const char *prefix);
functions.description: Stacktrace with a prefix label.
requirements: prefix may be NULL or a C string.

functions.name: janet_sandbox
functions.description: Enable sandbox restrictions specified by flags (bitmask of JANET_SANDBOX_*).
requirements: flags is a bitmask; irreversible or cumulative depending on implementation (unknown).

functions.name: janet_sandbox_assert
functions.description: Assert that the given forbidden_flags are not enabled; may panic if violated.

functions.name: janet_sfinalizer
functions.description: Attach a finalizer callback to a scratch memory block mem.
requirements: mem must be a pointer returned by scratch allocator APIs.
finalizer may be NULL to clear.

functions.name: janet_sfree
functions.description: Free scratch memory block mem.
requirements: mem must be from janet_smalloc/janet_srealloc/janet_scalloc.

functions.name: janet_def

requirements: env must be valid; sym a valid symbol.

functions.name: janet_resolve_core
functions.description: Resolve a core binding by C string name, returning its Janet value or nil if not found.
requirements: name must be a null-terminated C string.

functions.description: Register C functions with extended metadata (docstrings and source).
requirements: cfuns must be NULL-terminated using JANET_REG_END.
env must be valid.

functions.name: janet_cfuns_ext_prefix
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_cfuns_ext_prefix(JanetTable *env, const char *regprefix, const JanetRegExt *cfuns);
functions.description: Like janet_cfuns_ext with explicit prefix handling.
requirements: cfuns must be NULL-terminated.

functions.name: janet_def_sm
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_def_sm(JanetTable *env, const char *name, Janet val, const char *documentation, const char *source_file, int32_t source_line);

source_line is a source code line number.

functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_var_sm(JanetTable *env, const char *name, Janet val, const char *documentation, const char *source_file, int32_t source_line);
functions.description: Define a mutable var with docstring and source mapping metadata.
requirements: Same as janet_def_sm.

functions.name: janet_register
functions.signature: JANET_API void janet_register(const char *name, JanetCFunction cfun);
functions.description: Legacy API to register a single C function globally by name.
